# lib.rs

The workspace's one home for what is particular to a harness, a module a
harness, so no other crate names one (User). It depends on no other crate of
grammar's: the mcp crate takes it, and the Channel's own transports stay theirs.

## enum Harness
A client's harness by the name its `initialize` gives in `clientInfo`, which
tells a Claude Code from a Codex, so no harness argument is passed. A name it
doesn't know is `Other`, which takes the wss stream as Claude Code does.
